newsitem.title: USA: Harassment award cut to $350,000 from $50 million.
newsitem.headline: Harassment award cut to $350,000 from $50 million.

text.p: A federal appeals court Thursday slashed a jury award to $350,000 from $50 million for a woman who had sued Wal-Mart Stores Inc. for sexual harassment.

A panel of the U.S. Circuit of Appeals for the Eight District said the conduct which Peggy Kimzey was subjected to was "not the most egregious type of sexual conduct" and that the earlier award, which made national news, was excessive.

The $50 million punitive damage award came from a jury in 1995 after Kimzey sued the discount general store chain saying supervisors in the receiving department at Wal-Mart in Warsaw, Mo., had made disparaging remarks about her anatomy. She also won $35,000 in actual damages.
